name: oracle-forms-mcp
description: Read Oracle Forms modules (.fmb/.mmb/.pll/.olb) from a directory. Requires a JRE 21+ on PATH.
long_description:
Serves the content of Oracle Forms modules — `.fmb` forms, `.mmb` menus, `.pll` PL/SQL libraries, `.olb` object libraries — so an assistant can inspect blocks, items, triggers, program units, and raw object XML without opening Forms Builder, and record durable notes and relations on individual elements.

**Requires a Java runtime (JRE 21 or newer) on your PATH.** The MCPB manifest format can only declare Node and Python runtimes, so this prerequisite cannot be checked at install time — if the server fails to start, verify `java -version` works in a terminal.

This bundle is copy-mode capable only where the modules have already been converted to text (`*_fmb.xml` / `*.pld` sitting next to the modules). Converting binary `.fmb`/`.pll` in place additionally requires an Oracle Forms installation (`ORACLE_HOME`) on the machine; Oracle's `frmf2xml`/`frmcmp` tools are proprietary and are never bundled.

forms_dir.title: Forms directory
forms_dir.description: Directory containing the Oracle Forms modules to serve. Pre-converted *_fmb.xml / *.pld files are read from here too.

convert_command.title: Custom converter command (optional)
convert_command.description: Script or executable run instead of Oracle's frmf2xml, as `<command> <module>` with the working directory set to the module's cache directory. Leave empty to use an ORACLE_HOME installation, or pre-converted files next to the modules.

converted_dir.title: Converted XML directory (optional)
converted_dir.description: Where to keep the converted XML / .pld text forms — one flat directory for all modules, each file named after its module (orders_fmb.xml, utils.pld). Leave empty to keep them inside the cache. Must not be the forms directory.
